# Principal Abacus Cinch — *Equestria Girls*

Principal Cinch is the intimidating, status-obsessed head of Crystal Prep Academy and the main human antagonist of *My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games* (2015). She manipulates her best student, human-world Twilight Sparkle (“Sci-Twi”), to protect Crystal Prep’s undefeated reputation. She is a **human character in the Equestria Girls continuity**, not an established pony-world counterpart. [Hasbro’s film announcement](https://newsroom.hasbro.com/news-releases/news-release-details/stars-come-out-celebrate-third-installment-my-little-pony)

- **Look:** pale mint-blue skin; elaborately curled plum-and-pink hair; red half-rim glasses; pearl earrings; a cheek beauty mark; and a sharply tailored dark-blue suit with an orange-gem brooch.
- **Name:** “Principal Cinch” is the form used in dialogue and official promotion. **“Principal Abacus Cinch” is also official**, appearing in the film’s opening/closing credits and on Enterplay’s *Equestrian Friends* #27 card—not a fan invention. [Character and naming documentation](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Principal_Cinch)
- **Voice:** she speaks extensively and sings in “Unleash the Magic”; **Iris Quinn** is credited for her English voice. [Film cast credit](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4450396/characters/nm0703861)
- **Appearances:** onscreen in *Friendship Games* (2015), plus its out-of-continuity blooper reel; mentioned in *Legend of Everfree* (2016) and *Dance Magic* (2017). The latter establishes that **Cadance has replaced her** as Crystal Prep’s principal. [Equestria Girls character guide](https://equestriagirls.fandom.com/wiki/Principal_Cinch)

## Important moments

1. **The independent-study ultimatum** — *Friendship Games* (2015 film): Cinch threatens Twilight’s hoped-for independent study to force her into the school competition. [Official film upload, part 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v_eZi4YH7MQ) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **“Unleash the Magic”** — *Friendship Games* (2015 film): Cinch and the Shadowbolts pressure Twilight into opening her magic-collecting device, unleashing the transformation into Midnight Sparkle. [Official scene/song video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_t1RcxBKT80) — full-film timestamp unavailable.
3. **Her students reject her** — *Friendship Games* (2015 film): After the crisis, Cinch demands a forfeit, but Sugarcoat exposes her role and the school leaders refuse to indulge her accusation. [Authorized full-film listing](https://play.google.com/store/movies/details/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls_Friendship_Games?hl=en_US&id=ZfskeyiqiUE) — scene timestamp unavailable.
